subject: Adjudication criteria & evidence asks for ISO/FedRAMP staging
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <c.oneill@auditorspace.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <acme-security@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Adjudication approach for ISO / FedRAMP staging - initial asks

Hi Markus / Olga,

Thanks again for the call earlier. As we start to scope the evidence intake for AcmeCorp's planned FedRAMP readiness assessment and the ISO 27001 pre-audit, the audit team would like to confirm the adjudication thresholds and the minimal evidence pack we will accept during the staging window. To keep things practical ahead of the dry run, can you please provide the following by EOD Friday (2028-06-09):

- Primary control owner for each control in the attached mapping (control IDs in the attached template).
- For technical controls: the canonical log source + retention window and the location of a sample 30-day log export.
- For KMS/crypto: rotation evidence (policy + last rotation timestamp) and HSM/KMS attestation if available.
- For change management: one example change request, the approval chain, and the resultant deployment artifact.

We will exercise a lightweight adjudication rubric — Acceptable / Needs Clarification / Not Acceptable — and will flag any items requiring replay during the dry run. If there are known gaps (e.g., logs aggregated off-platform, air-gapped retainers), call them out so we can agree on compensating evidence.

Attached: draft_control_matrix (for mapping), quick intake template.

Cheers,
Claire O'Neill
Senior Assessor, Auditorspace

Attachment: draft_control_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <c.oneill@auditorspace.com>, Acme Security Team <acme-security@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Adjudication approach for ISO / FedRAMP staging - initial asks

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned on the timeline; we'll aim for the EOD Fri deliverable but I want to surface a couple of nuance items so expectations are set: 

1) Log exports: Our production logging for inference clusters is stored in a managed account (s3+lakehouse) and we can provide 30-day extracts, but the format is newline JSON with some custom fields. If your rubric requires field-level mappings, Kimberly will provide a small translation document.

2) KMS attestation: we rotate keys quarterly and have an internal rotation record; our HSM provider offers a whitepaper but not a signed attestation by default. We can provide the rotation policy (attached) plus a timestamped rotation audit log.

3) Control owners: Olga has started populating owners in the control-matrix-draft. We'll attach our current inventory (evidence_inventory_v2.csv) and point owners at specific evidence items.

Proposed next steps:
- Olga/Kimberly to complete owner column and add canonical log source by Fri 6/9 EOD.
- Kimberly to attach field-mapping for outbound logs by Monday 6/12.
- I'll schedule a 60m dry-run with your team the week of 6/12; is 6/15 10:00am PT available?

I've attached the control matrix draft and the evidence inventory export. If anything in Claire's list is non-negotiable for the adjudication rubric, flag it and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Platform & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: control-matrix-draft.xlsx (xlsx); evidence_inventory_v2.csv (csv)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire O'Neill <c.oneill@auditorspace.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Adjudication approach for ISO / FedRAMP staging - initial asks

Markus / team — quick internal update and clarifications (see inline).

> 1) Log exports... format is newline JSON with some custom fields. If your rubric requires field-level mappings, Kimberly will provide a small translation document.

Kimberly: I'm assigning you the field-mapping action. Deliverable: one-page CSV that maps our event fields to the auditor canonical names (time, principal_id, event_type, resource_id, payload). Target: Mon 6/12 EOD.

> 2) KMS attestation... We can provide the rotation policy (attached) plus timestamped rotation audit log.

Action: I'll attach the KMS rotation policy (kms-rotation-policy.pdf) and a zipped extract of our key-rotation events (referenced as a per-key CSV inside evidence_inventory_v2.csv). If the auditor needs an HSM vendor attestation we can request it, but that may push timelines by ~5 business days.

> 3) Control owners: Olga has started populating owners in the control-matrix-draft.

I've completed the owner column for the initial 40 controls that map to FedRAMP Moderate / ISO Annex A subsets. Owners are internal: Security Ops, Platform Infra, and Product PM for data classification controls. I'll update the Drive link in the sheet and flag any controls with partial evidence.

Open question for Markus: for change management evidence, the auditor asked for a single change request + deployment artifact. We typically have a multi-stage pipeline (PR -> CI -> canary -> prod). Which single instance is easiest to pull (PR URL + CI run + deployment manifest)? I recommend the 2028-05-18 hotfix (PR #3241) — it touches infra and has a full audit trail.

I'll push updates to the control matrix by EOD Fri.

—Olga
Director, Compliance Operations

Attachment: kms-rotation-policy.pdf (pdf)
From: Claire O'Neill <c.oneill@auditorspace.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Acme Security Team <acme-security@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Adjudication approach for ISO / FedRAMP staging - initial asks

Thanks Mark, Olga and Kimberly — helpful plan and timelines. A few clarifications before the dry run:

- Log field mapping: Acceptable as a CSV mapping; if any fields are opaque we will mark "Needs Clarification" and request a short replay.
- KMS: rotation policy + rotation event logs are acceptable for now. If Acme requires vendor-signed HSM attestation we will list that as a follow-up (not blocking the dry run).
- Change example: PR #3241 sounds good — we'll ask for PR link, CI run ID, and the prod manifest.

Dry-run scheduling: 6/15 10:00am PT confirmed for a 60m session (please invite relevant control owners). Objective: run three sample control adjudications — one logging control, one KMS/crypto control, one change management control — and capture rubric decisions.

Deliverables for the session: control-matrix with owners completed, 30d log export extract, KMS rotation extract, and the PR/CI/manifest package. If you can upload artifacts to the Drive folder ahead of time (link below) we'll use that as the primary intake.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcXYZ-control-artifacts
JIRA ticket for intake: SECOPS-429

See you on 6/15.

Claire O'Neill
Senior Assessor, Auditorspace
